budget.title: Full-Day City Fun + Teen-Friendly Budapest Nightlife on a Budget
budget.summary: Chill daytime exploring, affordable local food, and a fun, safe nighttime vibe with lights, music, desserts, and riverside hangouts.

schedule.title: Late Start in the City Center
schedule.description: Begin with an easy walk through central Pest — busy streets, cool shops, and historic vibes.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Grab something Hungarian and affordable: soup, paprikash, or a classic lángos.

schedule.title: Afternoon Chill or Café
schedule.description: Relax in a coffee shop with a soda, lemonade, or pastry. This is your recharge moment.

schedule.title: Cheap Dinner or Street Food
schedule.description: Hit an inexpensive food spot — pizza slice, gyro, noodles, or a second round of lángos.

schedule.title: Teen-Friendly Nightlife Warm-Up
schedule.description: Walk through the Jewish Quarter to see the famous ruin bar *exteriors* — full of lights and art — without going inside.

schedule.title: Arcade or Retro Game Spot
schedule.description: Visit a fun arcade or game café for safe nighttime energy — air hockey, pinball, old-school consoles.

schedule.title: Riverside Dessert Hangout
schedule.description: End the night at the Danube with ice cream, chimney cake (kürtőskalács), or a big lemonade.

comfortable.title: Full-Day City + Smooth Teen-Friendly Nightlife with Comfortable Dining
comfortable.summary: A relaxed day around Budapest, proper local meals, and a polished but youth-safe evening full of lights, views, and fun activities.

schedule.title: Late Morning City Walk
schedule.description: Walk the main streets and squares without rushing — enjoy the looks, sounds, and big city mood.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: Sit down at a nice Hungarian restaurant for classic dishes and a relaxed pace.

schedule.title: Rest or Scenic Coffee Spot
schedule.description: Hang out at a pleasant café — lemonades, hot chocolate, pastries — whatever you're feeling.

schedule.title: Local Dinner Before the Night Fun
schedule.description: Enjoy another local meal; try something different like stuffed cabbage, stew, or veggie dishes.

schedule.title: Evening Lights Walk
schedule.description: Walk through Budapest as the lights turn on — the Parliament, river, bridges… magical.

schedule.title: Teen-Friendly Music or Game Venue
schedule.description: Go to a safe space with live music (family-friendly), board games, arcade areas, or creative hangout spots.

schedule.title: Dessert Café or Sweet Finish
schedule.description: End with chimney cake, waffles, ice cream, or a cozy hot drink.

budget.title: Full-Day Easygoing + Light Veggie-Friendly Teen Nightlife
budget.summary: A comfy, relaxed day with lighter meals and a cheap, youth-safe nighttime adventure.

schedule.title: Center Walk + Fruit Drink
schedule.description: Start with a smoothie or lemonade while exploring central Pest streets.

schedule.title: Light Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Cheap, simple meals like veggie bowls, soups, or sandwiches.

schedule.title: Free Time or Park Walk
schedule.description: Relax in a park or wander around shops for a bit.

schedule.title: Light Dinner or Snacks
schedule.description: Veggie wraps, light pastas, salads — easy food before the night.

schedule.title: Budget Night Stroll
schedule.description: Walk through beautifully lit streets and see the outside murals of ruin bars.

schedule.title: Teen-Friendly Hangout Spot
schedule.description: Visit a gaming café, board game spot, or creative community space.

schedule.title: Sweet Treat Finish
schedule.description: End with a cheap dessert like chimney cake or ice cream.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Chill + Comfortable Light Dining + Teen-Safe Nightlife
comfortable.summary: A healthy, relaxed day followed by a polished but totally teen-appropriate night vibe.

schedule.title: Smooth Late Start
schedule.description: Walk around the center, grab a good coffee or herbal tea.

schedule.title: Light Quality Lunch
schedule.description: A nice restaurant with bowls, salads, veggie soups, or modern light dishes.

schedule.title: Recharge Time
schedule.description: Walk in a park, maybe check a bookstore or calm café.

schedule.title: Light Dinner
schedule.description: Comfortable bistro-style dining with lighter plates.

schedule.title: City Lights Tour
schedule.description: Walk around the Parliament, riverbanks, or Danube bridges at night — super pretty.

schedule.title: Youth-Safe Evening Spot
schedule.description: Board-game cafés, escape rooms, animation screenings, or live music suitable for teens.

schedule.title: Colorful Dessert Bar
schedule.description: Finish strong with waffles, crepes, or a fancy-looking lemonade.

budget.title: Full-Day City Vibes + Try-Everything Teen-Friendly Night Out (Budget)
budget.summary: A bit of sightseeing, a mix of cheap foods, and fun nighttime activities perfect for younger travelers.

schedule.title: Center Exploration
schedule.description: Visit the main squares and streets — just enough to warm up the day.

schedule.title: Mixed Cheap Lunch
schedule.description: Try a couple of small, affordable dishes — Hungarian or international.

schedule.title: Rest + Browse
schedule.description: Café break, souvenir shops, or simply chilling for a bit.

schedule.title: Street Food Dinner
schedule.description: Grab quick bites — noodles, gyros, fries, or veggie options.

schedule.title: Nighttime Bar-Hopping (Viewing Only)
schedule.description: Walk between the coolest ruin bars WITHOUT going in — the outsides are full of art and neon lights.

schedule.title: Game Café Stop
schedule.description: Hang out somewhere fun with board games, retro consoles, or air hockey.

schedule.title: Dessert Walk
schedule.description: Grab a sweet treat and stroll the Danube promenade.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Taste + Teen-Friendly Night Experience (Comfortable Dining)
comfortable.summary: A laid-back day of tasting lots of foods plus a safe, energetic nighttime experience.

schedule.title: Late Morning Wander
schedule.description: Central walk with fun little stops wherever something catches your eye.

schedule.title: Comfort Lunch with Variety
schedule.description: Try several different dishes — lighter, heavier, modern, anything you want.

schedule.title: Break + Snack
schedule.description: Recharge in a café with a dessert or small bite.

schedule.title: Dinner with Different Flavors
schedule.description: Sit down for a proper meal with multiple dishes to taste.

schedule.title: Evening Lights Stroll
schedule.description: Walk between famous landmarks — Parliament, Danube, bridges — all glowing.

schedule.title: Teen-Friendly Activity Spot
schedule.description: Safe evening fun: escape room, board-game café, arcade, or family-friendly music venue.

schedule.title: Sweet Night Finish
schedule.description: End with a dessert café or chimney cake stand. A+ finale.
